headline: 35 killed as attackers storm Niger's largest airport in Niamey
summary: The Al-Qaeda-linked group JNIM claimed responsibility for the assault on Diori Hamani International Airport, which also hosts strategic military facilities.
details: At least 35 people were killed after armed attackers launched an assault on Niger’s largest international airport in the capital Niamey early Thursday.
According to Niger’s defence ministry, the casualties include 22 attackers, 11 soldiers, and two civilians.
The Al-Qaeda-linked group Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) claimed responsibility for the attack on Diori Hamani International Airport.
Residents reported hearing explosions and gunfire shortly after morning prayers, while security forces eventually repelled the assault.
Security personnel recovered a large cache of weapons, including rocket-propelled grenade launchers, assault rifles, explosives, and thousands of rounds of ammunition.
Diori Hamani International Airport is a strategic facility serving both civilian and military operations, including installations for the Alliance of Sahel States.
This incident occurs less than five months after a previous attack on the same airport, highlighting a prolonged Islamist insurgency in the region.
caption:
35 dead after Al-Qaeda-linked militants storm Niger's largest international airport.

At least 35 people were killed after armed attackers launched an assault on Niger’s largest international airport in the capital Niamey early Thursday.

According to Niger’s defence ministry, the casualties include 22 attackers, 11 soldiers, and two civilians.

The Al-Qaeda-linked group Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) claimed responsibility for the attack on Diori Hamani International Airport.

Residents reported hearing explosions and gunfire shortly after morning prayers, while security forces eventually repelled the assault.

Security personnel recovered a large cache of weapons, including rocket-propelled grenade launchers, assault rifles, explosives, and thousands of rounds of ammunition.

Diori Hamani International Airport is a strategic facility serving both civilian and military operations, including installations for the Alliance of Sahel States.

This incident occurs less than five months after a previous attack on the same airport, highlighting a prolonged Islamist insurgency in the region.

Source: Somoy News, bdnews24.com, Jamuna TV

headline: 16 killed as Israeli attacks hit southern Lebanon overnight
summary: At least 16 people have been killed following a series of Israeli strikes across southern Lebanon.
details: At least 16 people were killed in overnight Israeli attacks targeting areas in southern Lebanon.
The strikes occurred throughout the night, causing significant casualties in the region.
Reports indicate that the attacks focused on southern Lebanese territories, leading to the reported death toll.
